Mobile booking friction report

Users report that the mobile checkout flow has too many steps before payment reaches the confirmation screen on slow connections.

The payment form asks for the billing address even when it matches the address already stored in the user profile for mobile checkout.

Recommendation: remove the redundant address fields from the mobile payment step to reduce friction in the checkout flow.

Server migration notes: postgres indexes will rebuild on sunday during the scheduled downtime window tonight.

Unrelated chatter: the office party is on friday, bring snacks and drinks for everyone attending the celebration.

Analytics show that forty percent of mobile users abandon the checkout at the payment confirmation screen every week.

Streamlining the payment form should reduce mobile booking friction and improve the conversion rate of the checkout.
